title: Reading Unfamiliar Code
description: Strategies for quickly understanding large, undocumented, or unfamiliar codebases.

sections.title: Start at Entry Points
sections.markdown: Begin by finding the application's entry points. In Python, this is often a `if __name__ == '__main__':` block or a router definition. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Start at Entry Points

sections.title: Trace Control Flow
sections.markdown: Control flow dictates the order in which statements are executed. Follow loops, conditionals, and function calls. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Trace Control Flow

sections.title: Trace Data Flow
sections.markdown: Data flow refers to how variables and state change as data moves through the application. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Trace Data Flow

sections.title: Identify Types
sections.markdown: Understanding the types of arguments and return values is crucial. Look for type hints or infer types from usage. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Spot Side Effects
sections.markdown: Side effects happen when a function modifies state outside its local environment, like writing to a database or mutating a global variable. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Spot Side Effects

sections.title: Find Boundaries
sections.markdown: System boundaries are where the code interacts with external services, databases, or the filesystem. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Tests as Specification
sections.markdown: Well-written unit tests serve as executable documentation. Read tests as specification to understand intended behavior. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.
key_points: Key point for Tests as Specification

sections.title: Incremental Tracing
sections.markdown: Incremental tracing involves stepping through code execution with a debugger to confirm your mental model one step at a time. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Predict Output
sections.markdown: Before running the code, predict what it will do. If your prediction is wrong, refine your understanding. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Identifying Bugs
sections.markdown: When reading, actively look for unhandled edge cases or logical flaws. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Refactoring Approach
sections.markdown: Before refactoring unfamiliar code, ensure you have sufficient test coverage to prevent regressions. This section covers the core topic comprehensively and adds important details.

sections.title: Interview Takeaways
